name: compact-joint-original54-v1
lean_basis: FlatSpectrum CM64-70: exact observed-row coordinates, weighted full-coordinate projection, fixed-family inclusion, lossless indexed UInt16 observations and repeated-row/complex-column storage with arbitrary fallback
historical_scope: Previous source and numerical summaries retained after user-authorized raw-output cleanup. Their historical verification is not a new replay of deleted raw artifacts.
stage_barrier: Seal every case and both required training endpoints before scoring any heldout pool. Model refusal stays in the full case denominator; I/O or disk shortage stops execution.
tensor_encoding: RDLT6401: every mass and unknown raw-class entry as exact binary64, bound dictionary and digest; deterministic complete complex head reconstruction
raw_records: Every ordered train and validation row, original target, all class logits, exact maximizers, numerical certificate and conditional anchor coverage. No target enters prediction.
repeat: Independently rebuild frozen source and repeat every training and scoring phase. Recount saved raw rows and compare every deterministic input, model, trace, raw artifact and summary hash.
scope: No target-realizability or floating-point projection theorem. Flat spectrum supplies a head-capacity bound; the fixed input-only family supplies a separate structural prior. Historical transformer scores remain reference results, without new transformer training.
observation_encoding: All original states and labels are checked UInt16 words, decoded one original row at a time. Full candidate partition, every original hash and legacy probe admission remain. Compact input bytes only admit inputs; nested actual-capacity checks admit each model operation. Every arbitrary unknown class remains free. No candidate pruning or record deduplication.
forward_processing: Zero gradient updates. Ordinary CE visits127-record minibatches and the final tail, sums in original order and divides once by total records.
shared_ram: Before a new large run, existing experiment pipelines must finish; no frozen process is stopped or restarted. Subtract other process RSS and2GiB growth reserve from110GB before local model admission. Report process allowance and measured peak in local logs.
probe_reader: Strict typed complete report; no cloned generic JSON tree. Every metadata and work counter is checked against the frozen composition protocol.
